propositions: /rerun and recheck-review requests are represented only in a process-local asyncio queue and disappear if the process exits before consumption, leaving stale voted entries that cause reconciliation to skip the revision
Reconciliation checks local voted state before querying Gerrit, skipping revisions with stale local dedup entries even after the Gerrit vote is reset

The fix establishes Gerrit as the durable source by resetting the exact revision to LLM-Review: 0, verifying no nonzero vote remains, then enqueueing the forced event—with the reset-emitted comment-added event serving as the durable marker across process loss
Reconciliation must query Gerrit first; a successful no-nonzero-vote read clears only the exact stale voted row via DedupStore.clear_voted before invoking the voter
Accepted /rerun and recheck-review requests must verify reset+no-vote before returning HTTP 202 or posting acceptance, rejecting if any nonzero vote survives a reset
Contributor comments can never select a label value; only privileged-side reset operations write exactly neutral LLM-Review: 0, with affirmative replies remaining label-free via post_comment
